subject.title: [Feature]: Feature request: Per-agent isolated browser instances with per-profile proxy support (concurrent execution)

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class browser profile proxy and per-agent browser binding in the bundled browser plugin, and what scope/security defaults should it use?
rationale: The requested fix defines new public config/API shape plus proxy credential, browser egress, and subagent session-ownership behavior that need maintainer-owned product and security decisions before implementation.

options.title: Design bundled browser support
options.body: Add browser.profiles.<name>.proxy with SecretRef-safe handling plus agents.*.browser.profile binding, explicit subagent inheritance/override semantics, diagnostics, and focused security tests.

options.title: Keep proxy external
options.body: Keep the current browser.extraArgs and remote-CDP workaround surface, document that per-profile proxying is not a core contract, and leave agent browser routing to explicit tool profile arguments.

options.title: Split the cluster
options.body: Track broader proxy policy in #60035 and subagent browser ownership in #85672 while using this issue only as the umbrella until both designs are ready.

recommendation.title: Design bundled browser support
recommendation.body: Add browser.profiles.<name>.proxy with SecretRef-safe handling plus agents.*.browser.profile binding, explicit subagent inheritance/override semantics, diagnostics, and focused security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across browser profile/config/runtime changes and is the best available owner for the product/security scope decision.
